ai.confirm.startTitle.description: Title of the question asked before a long run of AI on this PC starts (a Start button follows).

ai.what.sound.description: What an AI transcription sends, inside "Sends {what} to {where}" and the cost sentences of the cost line under an AI tool.

ai.cost.local.description: Cost line under an AI tool when it runs with AI on this PC and its time is not known yet.
